anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: Lemma restored from the Exodus wording.

pass_a_gloss: And if they are very few in the house so as not to be enough into a sheep, he shall take with himself the neighbor near him. According to number of souls each shall count with him what suffices him into a sheep. A sheep perfect, male, yearling it shall be for you. From the lambs and the kids you shall take. [gap]
pass_b_english: And if they are very few in the house, so as not to be enough for a sheep, he shall take with himself his neighbor who is near. According to the number of souls each shall count with him what is sufficient for him toward a sheep. A sheep perfect, male, a yearling, it shall be for you. From the lambs and the kids you shall take. [...] (Exodus 12:4–5).
source_text: [Ἐὰν δὲ ὀλίγιστοι ὦσιν ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ὥστε μὴ εἶναι ἱκανοὺς εἰς πρόβατον, συλλήψεται μεθ’ ἑαυτοῦ τὸν γείτονα τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ. Κατὰ ἀριθμὸν ψυχῶν ἕκαστος τὸ ἀρκοῦν αὐτῷ συναριθμήσεται εἰς πρόβατον. Πρόβατον τέλειον ἄρσεν ἐνιαύσιον ἔσται ὑμῖν. Ἀπὸ τῶν ἀρνῶν καὶ τῶν ἐρίφων λήψεσθε.] ...
